headline: Stlican Shelf Erupts Anew as Clashes Shift Along Northern Fronts
war_summary: The combat picture has shifted dramatically over the past three hours as fighting roars back into the eastern theater while the central axis partially fragments. Stlican Shelf, reported dormant in our prior dispatch, has violently reignited with eleven base transitions across Breaker Town and The Pale House over the last two hours. In contrast, the Dead Lands front has abruptly stalled, falling nearly silent with negligible recent casualties. Sustained, furious bloodshed nonetheless grips the northern and central belts. Weathered Expanse continues its grueling cycle of contestation, logging eight fresh base exchanges and heavy Warden losses, while adjacent Linn of Mercy tallied six transitions focused on The Long Whine. Heavy combat has also intensified in Callahan's Passage, where nearly two thousand casualties were recorded in two hours over The Latch, and in Viper Pit, where renewed deployments sparked three rapid base turnovers at Blackthroat. Marban Hollow maintains persistent instability around Mox, leaving the broad front fractured between localized grinding battles and swift eastern maneuver.
